title: release manifest (pops-manifest/1)
description: manifest.json of a signed release (tools/sign_release.py), carried base64-encoded in `update_agent`. The signature covers its exact bytes; the release tool writes it as sorted, 2-space indented JSON with a trailing newline. Agents parse it only after the signature is verified.

schema.description: Format; agents refuse any other value.

version.description: Release version (semantic version); must be newer than the agent's own.

artifacts.description: Files of the release. `update_agent` requires exactly one Windows agent package (POps-Agent-<version>-win-x64.msi).

size.description: Size in bytes (the Windows agent accepts at most 512 MiB).
